title: Adaptive FastLane: Risk-Scaled Onboarding for Legacy Airgap/VPC Customers
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create an adaptive, rule-based FastLane and operator playbook that evaluates incoming Private/VPC/on-prem customer requests for airgapped or severely constrained-network environments. The goal is to make an eligibility and remediation decision within 48 hours for >=75% of requests and reduce manual engineering triage by creating a scoring engine, self-serve probes, and clear remediation lanes. Scope: network/upgrade/airgap readiness checks, intake UX changes, runbook templates for Solutions Engineering (SE) and Oncall, pilot automation to flag low-risk requests for expedited onboarding. Non-goals: building on-prem installers or changing our core runtime; full automation of complex migrations that require on-site engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring engine implemented as a serverless decision endpoint and integrated into intake form
Intake UI shows network posture score and recommended remediation lane to customers and SEs
Operator runbook (PDF + Markdown) with play-by-play remediation flows for Low/Medium/High risk
Pilot executed with 6 customers: decision within 48 hours for >=75% of pilot requests
Dashboard metrics available in Console: time-to-decision, escalation rate, and self-serve pass rate
success_metrics: Median time-to-decision <= 24 hours for automated-pass requests
Manual-engineering triage reduced by 60% for pilot cohort
>=50% of requests complete with recommended remediation before SE intervention
Escalation rate to ENG < 20% for pilot cohort
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Pilot): build schema + scoring rules + intake UI changes; run with 6 strategic customers over 6 weeks
Phase 2 (Scale): add automated network probes and integrations with SE tooling; onboard 25 customers over 8 weeks
Phase 3 (Automation): expose self-serve remediation scripts and template configs; reduce human checks for Low risk
Phase 4: bake into standard Private/VPC onboarding flow and link to Dedicated/SLA lanes
risk_mitigation: Fallback: all automated decisions are logged and reversible; human-in-the-loop for any uncertain score
Canary: enable scoring only for inbound requests that opt-in to pilot to limit blast radius
Security review: KMS/HSM, audit logging and data handling reviewed by Security team before pilot
Legal/Compliance: explicit consent flow for customers sharing network telemetry or running probes
automation_tasks: Implement serverless scoring endpoint (Lambda) with feature toggles
Add lightweight network probe script that customers can run and upload results
Intake UI: show dynamic remediation checklist and estimated time-to-onboard
Console: basic dashboard with decision outcomes and per-customer timeline
